label: Creek and pond banks
summary: Tall, uneven grass on the banks of the creeks and ponds a builder marked, from the water's edge up to the top of the bank, and in clumps out into the water.
steps: Plants a creek or pond when its bankVeg attribute names a palette: 'default' is the creek_bank type's Default mix, any other value one of its variants (vass, reed, thicket, lush, ...). An unmarked one is planted only inside a hand-drawn creek_bank section.
Per creek it works on a 0.25 m grid from Unity's surface map and the terrain's edited DEM. The water is the creek's outline plus the OPCD water surface right beside it.

The bank is the ground next to the water that rises at the slope limit or more and is connected to the water through such ground: walking out from the water, it ends where the ground first flattens (the top of the bank), never further than the creek's bankVegMaxM and never nearer than min-bank.
The weight is 1 on the bank and fades to 0 just beyond its top; noise shifts that edge in and out so it is ragged.

Out in the water, grass grows in from both shores with a ragged edge and some clumps further out until it covers the creek's bankVegCover share of the water; a winding strip of open water usually stays down the middle.
A rock slab standing in the water or on the bank gets a ragged ring of grass round it in the water, and only tall-rough's slab fringe and patches on the rock itself.

When the course's creek_bank type has a '<palette>_wet' variant, the water and the lower bank (bankVegWetM from the water) go to that wet mix (cattails, reeds) and the rest of the bank to the palette's own mix.

A hand-drawn creek_bank zone (a section) gives the banks inside it its own palette, blending into the creek's palette over a ragged hand-over; later sections sit on top. The section itself is not planted.
Keeps off tees, greens, fairways, semis, bunkers, other OPCD meshes, other water, paths and bridges, houses and roads, each with a clearance and a fade.

The weight field is written as nested contour bands, one creek_bank zone per band polygon with the palette as its variant. These zones sit above the tall rough, which runs up to the marked creeks without its water clearance.

rules.text: The drawn features whose banks can be planted (marked with bankVeg, or inside a section).
Share of the water surface the grass covers, when the creek has no bankVegCover of its own.
How far up the bank the grass reaches at most, when the creek has no bankVegMaxM of its own.
Grass at least this far from the water, flat banks too.
The bank ends where the ground flattens below this slope (the top of the bank).
The DEM is smoothed over this before the slope is measured (lidar speckle).
OPCD water surface within this of the creek's outline counts as the creek's water.
Water surface further than this from the creek's water is other water (kept clear).
Beyond the top of the bank the weight falls from 1 to 0 over this.
The fade is shifted in and out by up to this much, so the top edge is ragged.
Size of the noise blobs that shift the top edge.
How much noise is added to the shore-to-mid-stream score (0..1) that decides which water cells get grass.
Size of the noise blobs of the clumps in the water.
The creek's local half-width is its deepest water within a window this wide.
Clumps in the water smaller than this are dropped.
A ring of grass this wide on average (0 to 2 x by noise) round a rock slab in the water or on the bank.
The ring is never narrower than this: grass right up against the rock all round.
Size of the noise blobs that vary the ring's width.
The wet mix reaches this far up the bank from the water, when the creek has no bankVegWetM of its own.
It hands over to the palette's own mix over this (shorter with a shorter reach).
The hand-over is shifted by up to this much noise (less with a shorter reach).
Size of the noise blobs that shift the hand-over.
A section's palette hands over to the next one over this, along the creek.
The hand-over is shifted by up to this much noise, so the change is not a straight cut.
Size of the noise blobs that shift the hand-over.
Per surface: no grass within 'clear' metres, full grass beyond clear + ramp. Other = OPCD meshes that are none of the course surfaces.
No grass within this of other water (another creek or pond, or water surface away from this creek) ...
... full grass beyond the clearance plus this.
No grass within this of the drawn paths and bridges: grass cards are about 1 m wide and lean, so they must not hang over the path.
Full grass beyond the path clearance plus this.
Kept clear around house footprints (the building survey).
Kept clear beyond a surveyed road's edge (centerline + half its width, an estimate).
Beyond the house and road margins the grass fades in over this.
The tall rough keeps no water clearance on the marked creeks and this far round them (the bank zones take the banks).
The zone type of the zones (its Default mix and variants are the palettes).
The contour levels the weight field is written at (one zone per band; the top band has weight 1).
Feather of each band zone.
Band pieces smaller than this are dropped.
Outlines are simplified to this tolerance.
